historical_statement: For an i.i.d. elliptic nearest-neighbor random environment on Z^d, d >= 3, and any nonzero direction l, the annealed probability P_0(A_l), A_l = {X_n dot l -> +infinity}, belongs to {0,1}.

historical_primary_source.location: Drewitz--Ramirez, Open question 3.2, PDF page 42, text lines 2614-2617; Definition 2.3 on PDF page 7
historical_primary_source.quote: Open question 3.2. Consider a RWRE satisfying the assumptions (E) and (IID). Is it true that for every l in S^{d-1} one has P_0[A_l] in {0,1}?
historical_primary_source.assumptions: (E) means almost-sure strict positivity of all nearest-neighbor probabilities at every site; (IID) applies to site rows; P_0 is the annealed law. No uniform lower bound is imposed.
